summary: Fresh verification passes the current production build, 98 unit tests, lint, the 16-test production browser suite, the isolated 5-test visual suite, 64-file WebP decoding, the 56-item formal-art audit, runtime matrices, and both structural validators. Manual inspection also confirms the repaired 844x390 settings layout and the required art sheets. AC12 nevertheless fails because raw/manual-visual-review.md is still the pre-fix review: it names baseline eeb5812, says the fresh build failed, marks AC8 FAIL, and concludes the task does not pass, directly contradicting the current evidence bundle's all-PASS/no-gaps claim.

criteria.reason: The typed 56-item formal manifest, current unit assertions, fresh production build, 30/30 character matrix, 16/16 CG matrix, runtime request checks, unique hashes, and full WebP decode audit pass. Forbidden-pattern hits are confined to explicit non-art fallbacks, legacy background typing, negative tests, proof screenshots, and the static server SVG MIME table.

Fresh public-UI E2E produces a complete 30/30 runtime matrix with successful visible requests. Independent inspection of the regenerated character contact sheet and representative originals confirms six stable identities, distinct required states, usable transparency, and no decisive watermark, text, limb, costume, or crop defect.

Fresh public-UI E2E reaches all seven scene CGs and nine unique ending CGs with no missing keys. The regenerated CG sheet and representative runtime frames are distinct, narratively legible, consistent with the dark tomb art direction, and not visibly stretched or critically obscured.

The three unique formal UI artworks are present and visible at all four contract viewports. Fresh 844x390 top/bottom screenshots and automated bounding-box, clipping, hit-testing, and scroll-reachability assertions confirm the repaired settings content is non-overlapping and fully reachable.

Fresh full and isolated browser runs exercise six player effects and the enemy response in order, including request abort, next-turn recovery, and reduced motion. Production code uses 120 ms per reduced-motion art phase, normal phases use 520 ms, and rendered effect layers remain non-interactive and below controls.

The current trace contains 56 unique complete records, 56 repository-retained originals, adopted ImageGen call IDs, full prompts, references, and allowed post-processing. Independent inspection of all four regenerated contact sheets plus representative full-resolution files finds a coherent semi-realistic dark Chinese fantasy style and no decisive disqualifying artifact.

The read-only decode audit passes all 64 discovered release WebPs; the formal audit passes 56 unique hashes and reports 5,165,122 total bytes with all class-specific limits met. A fresh clean-context homepage observation requests one image totaling 33,040 bytes, below both frozen thresholds.

Fresh browser coverage passes the four required viewports, no-global-overflow checks, internal settings scrolling, contrast thresholds, focus-visible traversal, deterministic screenshots, portrait rotation prompt, and reduced-motion behavior. Manual inspection of the repaired 844x390 settings top and bottom confirms no remaining overlap or unreachable control.

The fresh 16-test production suite passes all four routes, seven required scene nodes, and nine endings through the public UI, regenerating complete matrices and runtime screenshots from the just-built out/ export without missing asset keys.

Fresh unit and production browser coverage passes manual and quick save/load, return-to-menu reload, version-6 missing-visual-metadata compatibility, all required combat actions and effects, request degradation, reduced motion, and victory/failure flows.

The prescribed gates pass freshly in sequence: pnpm test 98/98, pnpm lint, pnpm build, pnpm test:e2e:run 16/16, and the isolated visual-art suite 5/5. The new build produced out/index.html before browser execution.

Both JSON/proof validators pass structurally, but the required raw/manual-visual-review.md is stale and internally contradicts evidence.md/evidence.json: it identifies the pre-fix baseline, says the current build failed, marks AC8 FAIL, and concludes the task does not pass. Therefore the criterion-level bundle is not wholly current or internally consistent despite valid schema and paths.
